background.comment: tables.scss:15 — background-color: variables.$white, a literal #fff (_variables.scss:29, NOT a var()). Flat, no brandChannel.

color.comment: tables.scss:18 — color: variables.$secondary, compiles to var(--brand-secondary) (confirmed via direct dart-sass compilation of the file). Renders for any plain (non-th, non-anchor) text directly inside a td — no more specific rule sets `color` on bare `td` (only `th` gets its own color rule, tables.scss:65).

font-size.comment: tables.scss:20 — font-size: variables.$content-font-size, compiles to var(--uiowa-font-size-body), the semantic alias whose {ref} is typography.font-size.150 (1.2rem, tokens/semantic/typography-usage.json body.font-size). LOW-CONFIDENCE CAVEAT (see openQuestions, not asserted as a claim): every element inside a table that can actually contain text — caption, td, th, p, ul, ol — declares its own more specific font-size (confirmed via direct dart-sass compilation: none of those rules omit font-size), so this value may never paint visible text. Tokenized as-shipped regardless; not proven to 'never render' the way the caption-link/gray-borders>caption claims are.

line-height.comment: tables.scss:21 — line-height: 1.15 (literal). NEW primitive proposed (see newPrimitives): no existing step matches (nearest neighbor is line-height.112 = 1.125). UNLIKE table/font-size above, this demonstrably renders: `<caption>` (tables.scss:106-122) sets its own font-size/color/background/padding/font-weight but declares NO line-height override (confirmed via compilation), so caption's line-height is this inherited 1.15 value.
